chunks: And it is narrated in another hadith:
"Except if it is a cold winter, in which case you should protect the deceased from that from which you protect yourself."

key_terms.آخَرَ: another, indicating this report comes through a separate narration
key_terms.حَدِيثٍ: a narrated report from the tradition

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be treated during extremely cold winter weather in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling regarding the handling of the deceased in severely cold weather. It indicates that the deceased should be safeguarded from harmful cold just as a living person would protect himself, reflecting dignity and care in funerary rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.395 - It is also narrated in another hadith:
"Except if it is a cold winter, in which case, you should protect the deceased as you would protect yourself."
